title: Financial Resilience Evaluation: From Conditional Expectations to Dynamic Convex Risk Measures
abstract: arXiv:2606.30070v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Financial resilience concerns whether, and how rapidly, a risky position recovers or deteriorates at a future time $t$, given the information available at time $s\leq t$. As a first step, the resilience rate was introduced as the expected instantaneous rate of change of a price or risk-assessment process. Because this quantity captures only the conditional mean of future increments, it cannot distinguish between positions with the same expected recovery but different conditional risk profiles. We obtain a richer characterization by evaluating such increments through a possibly nonlinear dynamic risk measure $\rho$. For an It\^o process $\pi$ and a normalized, cash-additive $\rho$, we define the resilience evaluation as the $L^1$-limit of $\varepsilon^{-1}\rho_s(\pi_{t+\varepsilon}-\pi_t)$, as $\varepsilon\to 0^+$, whenever it exists. translated_title: 金融韧性评估：从条件期望到动态凸风险度量
translated_abstract: 金融韧性关注的是，在给定 s≤t 时刻可得信息的条件下，一个风险头寸在未来时刻 t 是否会恢复或恶化，以及其变化速度有多快。作为第一步，韧性率被引入为价格或风险评估过程的期望瞬时变化率。由于该量仅刻画未来增量的条件均值，它无法区分那些具有相同期望恢复但条件风险特征不同的头寸。我们通过一个可能非线性的动态风险度量 ρ 来评估此类增量，从而获得了更丰富的刻画。对于一个 Itô 过程 π 和一个规范化、现金可加的 ρ，我们将韧性评估定义为 ε⁻¹ρ_s(π_{t+ε}−π_t) 当 ε→0⁺ 时的 L¹ 极限（若该极限存在）。对于由具有 Lipschitz 或二次型驱动的 BSDE 所诱导的凸风险度量 ρ，我们证明了该极限的存在性以及一个对偶……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文将金融韧性评估从基于条件期望的韧性率推广到由带 Lipschitz 或二次驱动的 BSDE 诱导的动态凸风险度量，通过刻画风险头寸恢复或恶化增量的瞬时风险评估极限，能够区分期望恢复相同但条件风险特征不同的头寸。
